svg.title: Failure before tool entry differs from failure after it
svg.desc: A malformed request is rejected by validation without entering the tool body. A valid and authorized request can enter execution; a later crash means execution started and effects may need inspection. Cancellation stops new scheduling and cleans up the tested execution unit before reporting its outcome. Neither a crash nor cancellation authorizes an automatic retry of an uncertain mutation. The lesson's injected crash is read-only, while the distinction explains the broader recovery rule.
